_note: Chronicle text in the voice of the Grey Scribes (docs/world.md: neutral chroniclers based in the Crownhaven archive). Phrasings are chosen with the campaign's seeded random generator. {placeholders} are filled by core/chronicle.gd.

opening.title: The Oath of Stillwater Is Void
opening.text: In this year the oath that bound the great houses to peace was declared void. The Grey Scribes, keeping no allegiance, take up the record of every realm.

year_begins: The {ordinal} year is entered in the archive
summary_title: Year {year}, as Set Down at Crownhaven
summary_open: The Grey Scribes set down the following.
Let it be recorded, without favour, as follows.
The archive at Crownhaven notes the year thus.
faction_line: {faction} closed the year with {treasury} gold ({net} on the year); its people number {population} ({growth}).
The coffers of {faction} stood at {treasury} gold ({net}); {population} souls live under its banner ({growth}).
richest_line: Of all the realms, {faction} holds the fullest treasury.
None counted more gold this year than {faction}.
building_text: The builders of {faction} finished the {building} at {settlement} this year.
Let it be recorded that {faction} completed the {building} at {settlement}.
upgrade_text: {settlement} grew in standing this year: {faction} raised it to {building}.
Under {faction}, {settlement} became {building}, and its streets spread accordingly.
war_text: The Grey Scribes record that {attacker} took up arms against {defender}. The Oath of Stillwater binds them no longer.
In this year {attacker} marched against {defender}, and the archive marks the two as at war.
battle_text: {winner} defeated {loser} at {place}. {winner_men} men of the victors fell, and {loser_men} of the vanquished.
At {place} the host of {winner} broke the army of {loser}; the dead were {winner_men} for the victors and {loser_men} for the beaten.
capture_text: The banners over {place} are now those of {faction}.
surrender_text: Starved after a long siege, {place} opened its gates to {faction}.
siege_text: The host of {faction} has drawn its lines around {place}; the Grey Scribes count the granaries and wait.
Before {place} the banners of {faction} are planted. None go in or out.
withdraw_text: Faced with the host of {attacker}, {faction} drew back from the field near {place} rather than fight.
Near {place} the army of {faction} broke camp and slipped away from {attacker}.
general_killed: {name} of {faction} did not leave the field alive.
general_wounded: {name} of {faction} was carried wounded from the field.
captain_promoted: For the victory, {name} of {faction} was raised to command.
